task.title: Uploading animal photos
task.shortdesc: Good photos are the biggest factor in how quickly an animal is adopted. Add them from a computer or straight from your phone.

context.p: Each animal can have up to 20 photos and 3 videos. The first photo is the primary photo on listings and kennel cards.

step.cmd: On the Profile tab, drag photos onto the photo strip, or click Add photos.
In the app, tap Camera and take the photo. It uploads automatically, even if you're offline when you take it.
Drag the best photo to the first position to make it the primary photo.
Optional: click a photo and add a caption.

info.p: Captions are read aloud by screen readers on your public listings, so describe what's in the photo.

result.p: New photos appear on public listings within 15 minutes.
